title: CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier
summary: This guide lists CLI eligibility requirements by card tier—Entry-tier (min account age $120 days, $120-day cooldown, utilization below 70%), Mid-tier (90 days/90 days/below 80%), Premium-tier (60 days/60 days/below 90%). All three criteria must be met at request time; cooldown applies only after approved requests and denied requests don’t trigger cooldown.
faqs: What are the minimum account age requirements to request a CLI for Entry-tier, Mid-tier, and Premium-tier?
How many days is the cooldown between CLI requests by card tier, and does it apply after denied requests?
Does my credit utilization qualify if it equals the threshold (e.g., 70% / 80% / 90%)?
When does the minimum account age/cooldown requirement “start” for eligibility (e.g., on the exact day)?
What quick checklist should I verify before submitting a CLI request for my tier?
